ServicesShowcase.sectionTitle: Our Services – Framing Dreams Into Reality
ServicesShowcase.sectionIntro: From artists and music creators to couples and corporate teams, we capture every story with heart—turning your moments into lasting visual art

weddingsQuinceañeras.name: Weddings & Quinceañeras
weddingsQuinceañeras.summary: We beautifully document the emotions, details, and joy of weddings and quinceañeras, blending cinematic visuals with authentic moments to preserve your most unforgettable celebrations

eventsCorporateCoverage.summary: From energetic parties to formal corporate galas, we capture your event's atmosphere and key moments with dynamic photography and video that brings the entire experience to life

ClientStoriesExperiences.sectionTitle: Moments That Matter - Stories from Our Clients
ClientStoriesExperiences.sectionIntro: Don't just take our word for it. Discover the experiences of those who entrusted us with their most important moments. Their stories are the heart of what we do

clientStories.imgDesc: Joyful newlywed couple embracing, captured in a warm, candid moment
clientStories.testimonial: Every single moment was captured beautifully—from the quiet tears during our vows to the wild energy on the dance floor. Looking through our album feels like stepping back into the best day of our lives
clientStories.clientInfo: Maria & Juan | Newlyweds | Panama City | Wedding Ceremony

clientStories.imgDesc: Smiling quinceañera posing in her elegant gown with her parents at her celebration
clientStories.testimonial: They made me feel like a princess from start to finish. The way they captured my entrance, the traditions, and all those little moments with my family—it's everything I dreamed of and more
clientStories.clientInfo: Sofia Martinez | Quinceañera | San Miguelito | Quinceañera Celebration

clientStories.imgDesc: A stylish professional woman in festive attire, joyfully raising her glass at a lively corporate gathering
clientStories.testimonial: Pawis Crea elevated our company gala with professional, engaging coverage that showcased our brand's energy and our team's spirit. The final deliverables exceeded every expectation!
clientStories.clientInfo: Ana Rodriguez | Marketing Manager | Business District | Corporate Event Coverage

clientStories.imgDesc: Confident fashion model in dramatic studio lighting for high-fashion editorial shoot
clientStories.testimonial: Working with Pawis Crea was inspiring. They captured my unique style and personality, creating stunning, high-confidence images that are perfect for my portfolio
clientStories.clientInfo: Lucia Fernandez | Fashion Model | Studio Location | Fashion Portrait Session

OurStory.imgAltText: The founder of Pawis Crea capturing a moment with their camera
OurStory.description: At Pawis Crea, we craft stories through photography and videography, turning fleeting moments into timeless treasures. Our passionate team collaborates with clients—artists, couples, businesses—to bring their visions to life with expressive portraits, dynamic event coverage, and impactful brand visuals. We capture the beauty and emotion of each moment, creating memories that resonate long after the shutter clicks
